titles.title: To amend section 337 of the Tariff Act of 1930 to ensure that the resources of the United States International Trade Commission are focused on protecting genuine domestic industries, to safeguard the public health and welfare and the United States economy, and to improve the transparency of third party litigation funding, and for other purposes.
